description: Source code for shared processing utilities involving parsing, indexing, and handling uploaded files such as JSON, XLSX, and general files (.txt, .pdf, .docx). Implements functions for extracting content, generating previews, indexing data into session context, and a main interface for processing multiple files asynchronously with progress updates.

methods.description: Processes XLSX data: converts sheets to row chunks, summarizes preview, indexes into session.

methods.description: Processes general files (.txt, .pdf, .docx): extracts text, summarizes, and indexes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] process_files( session_id: str, files_data: List[Tuple[str, bytes]], progress_callback: Optional[Callable[[int, str], None]] = None, )
methods.description: Main public interface to process multiple uploaded files asynchronously, update session context, and generate progress updates.
